text:
Renee Park: FYI seeing a small crop of 429s on embed-service prod-eu (started ~22:10). low volume but recurring. thinking v2.2.1-hotfix to tighten conn pool backoff. Can we do an expedited squeeze at 22:20-22:30 UTC?
Dmitri Kovalenko: what's the artifact and risk surface?
Renee Park: artifact is v2.2.1-hotfix (backoff tweak + circuit guard). tiny diff. CI green.
Sofia Gomez: QA can run a 5m smoke + 3m perf litmus in parallel. If ops will allow a short canary-skip we can finish in time.
QA Pipeline: running smoke now (tests 1-12). ETA 4m.
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.2.1-hotfix -> prod-eu (4 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-6792012345. tracking: https://internal/redwood/deploys/6792012345
Dmitri Kovalenko: ops, can we accept canary=false for this squeeze?
OpsBot: opsbot: one-shot canary-skip allowed for 10m window if QA cert completes. rollback criteria: sustained error-rate >0.8% OR any 5xx burst >1.5% for 2m. Need human ack in thread before we unpin.
Renee Park: noted. if QA passes we'll pin to eu-hotfix pool and monitor 12m. rollback: `trafficctl rollback --service embed-service --to v2.2.0 --reason "auto-rollback"`
QA Pipeline: smoke passed. perf quick-check: 95p latency improved ~70ms, no functional regression. :white_check_mark:
Sofia Gomez: recommending go. I'll keep synthetic checks running.
Dmitri Kovalenko: applying pin now on my mark. Command: `trafficctl pin --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.2.1-hotfix --note "squeeze-6792012345"`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied to eu-hotfix. routing update propagated to 3 LBs.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/4 ready). healthcheck path=/healthz expecting 200.
Renee Park: monitors: increased trace sampling, synthetic user queries hitting edge. If 429s drop by >50% in 6m we consider full rollout.
DeployBot: deploybot: progress 2/4 ready. no failing healthchecks.
Sofia Gomez: quick observation: initial replicas see higher conn churn during cold start but stabilizes after 90s. watch 6m.
Dmitri Kovalenko: holding full rollout until 8m steady. Ops 1: if >1% 5xx for 90s, roll back and unpin.
OpsBot: ack. rollback playbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/embed-rollback.md
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout complete (4/4 ready). run_id=deploy-6792012345. live traffic on v2.2.1-hotfix.
QA Pipeline: 10m watch complete: 429s reduced ~70%, 95p latency stable, no new errors. LGTM.
Renee Park: posting release-note snippet shortly. ReleaseNotesBot: please draft a short blurb.
ReleaseNotesBot: draft: "embed-service v2.2.1-hotfix 1/ tightens connection backoff and adds circuit guard to mitigate intermittent 429s in EU. Deployed during 22:20-22:30 UTC and pinned to eu-hotfix pool for 12 minutes while monitored. QA passed; rollback criteria documented."
Sofia Gomez: leave pin for 12m as discussed, then auto-unpin. Command queued: `trafficctl unpin --after 12m --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service`
Dmitri Kovalenko: will follow up with a short postmortem on root cause; suspect a transient client-side burst combined with slightly aggressive keepalive.
Renee Park: thanks all. closing thread once unpin completes and postmortem ticket is opened. :thumbsup:
